whatIs.heading: What is Spektt?
whatIs.body: Spektt is the platform built for creatives — photographers, videographers, 3D animators, digital artists, sound engineers, and more. Share your work, enter Showdowns to compete for real prizes, join Clusters to find your creative niche, and grow in a community that actually values what you make.

items.desc: Enter creative competitions, get judged by the community and expert panels, and win real cash prizes.
Join communities built around your creative niche — from street photography to 3D animation.
Share your work with the world. Photos and videos, delivered fast to a global audience of creatives.
Unlock priority visibility, unlimited uploads, and a 25% XP boost with Spektt Pro.
Earn XP, climb the rankings, and see where you stand against the global creative community.
Connect and collaborate with other creatives directly through built-in DMs.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.desc: Download Spektt, sign up in minutes, and pick your creative category — photography, videography, 3D animation, and more.

steps.title: Upload your work
steps.desc: Post photos and videos straight from your camera roll. Your work goes live on your profile and in the global feed instantly.

steps.title: Compete and grow
steps.desc: Enter Showdowns, earn XP, climb the leaderboard, win prizes, and get discovered by a global community of creatives.

showdowns.heading: Showdowns
showdowns.subtitle: Creative competitions open to everyone. Submit your work, let the community vote, and see where you rank.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.body: 100% fan-voted. The community decides the winner — no judges, no panels. The entry with the most votes wins.

premium.name: Premium
premium.body: Two-stage judging. Fans vote to pick the top 20, then expert judges score the finalists. Fan votes and judge scores each count for 50%.

cta.heading: Ready to compete? Download Spektt.
cta.subtitle: Free to download. Available on iOS and Android.

about.heading: What is
about.p1: Are you ready to take your creative journey to the next level? Spektt is the platform built for creatives — photographers, videographers, 3D animators, digital artists, sound engineers, and more — to showcase their work, compete for real prizes, and connect with a global community that actually values what they make.
about.p2: We built Spektt because we know firsthand the challenges that come with being a creative in today's fast-paced digital world. Getting your work seen is hard. Finding your community is harder. That's why we created a platform that puts your creativity at the centre — with the tools, the audience, and the opportunities to match.
about.p3: Spektt is built around Showdowns — creative competitions where you submit your work, the community votes, and expert judges weigh in. Pulse Showdowns are 100% fan-voted. Premium Showdowns combine fan votes with judge scores, with real cash prizes on the line. Every Showdown is a chance to get discovered.
about.p4: Beyond competitions, Spektt gives you a feed to share your work, Clusters to find your niche community, a leaderboard to track your standing, and a milestone system that rewards you for every step of your creative journey. The more you create, the more you grow.
about.p5: At Spektt, we believe geography should never be a barrier to recognition. We're building a platform where any creative, anywhere in the world, can access the same opportunities, the same stage, and the same chance to be seen.
about.p6: Spektt is more than a platform — it's a community. Whether you're just starting out or already established, you'll find your people here. Join the Showdowns, build your profile, and let your work speak for itself.
